slots.name: Shahed interception rate
slots.sentence: More than three-fourths of Russia’s Shahed unmanned aerial vehicles and cruise missiles are intercepted, using drones, fourth-generation fighter aircraft, and other platforms.

slots.name: ballistic interception rate
slots.sentence: Ukraine’s military is only able to intercept one-third or so of them, according to the Ministry of Defense.

slots.name: drone production
slots.sentence: In the time it takes to brush one’s teeth, one drone factory I visited will have already produced 15 drones.

slots.name: Donetsk remaining population
slots.sentence: the mere 20% or so of his constituents who remain in Ukrainian territory are spending their days underground in bomb shelters.

slots.name: Russian casualty share
slots.sentence: Russia’s massive and growing casualties— estimated by the Economist to be 3% of its fighting-age male population
